title: Lapilli chart values
description: Unknown keys in Lapilli's own sections are rejected so a typo can't be silently ignored. `global` is allowed for umbrella charts. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md §5.

digest.description: Pin the image by digest: set, the pod runs repository@digest and the tag is not rendered at all. Empty (default) keeps the tag, because a private mirror of the same image has a different digest.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets the kubelet uses to pull the image from a private registry, as on a pod spec: [{name: regcred}]. Empty (default): the image is public.

reconcileConcurrency.description: How many captures may be collected at once. 0 is unbounded, which is kube-rs's default and was measured to reach 80% of a 256Mi limit on a 20-alert storm.

name.description: A CaptureProfile object name, so an RFC 1123 subdomain. The CRD carries the same pattern on spec.profile: a value this accepts and the CRD refuses would install and then never produce a capture.

deferred.description: Collectors this profile declares it does not run because the data is kept elsewhere; recorded in every bundle as coverage.deferred. Must not overlap collectors (the CRD's CEL rule refuses the overlap at apply time; JSON Schema cannot express it here).

notifyRoute.description: The name of a notify.routes entry whose channel this profile's captures are announced in. Empty (default): not announced.

prometheusUrl.description: Empty (off) or an http(s) base URL with a plain host[:port] and an optional path prefix. No credentials, query, fragment or bracketed IP literal (write a name or an IPv4 literal): the controller refuses those, and plain http:// only for cluster-local or loopback hosts.

redaction.description: Credential redaction of captured objects before they are written into a bundle. Best-effort; container logs are never redacted (DESIGN.md §5).

mode.description: default | strict | off. NO ADMIN FLOOR: this renders into the CaptureProfile and the controller uses the profile's mode as given, so anyone who can patch a CaptureProfile can set `off` and every later bundle carries env values, args, probe headers and annotations unredacted to every destination that profile names. Export destinations, notify routes and KMS signing are all pinned by the admin; redaction is not. `off` is recorded in the bundle and flagged by `lapilli verify`. An admin floor (redaction.minimumMode) is a v0.2 item.

persistence.description: Where sealed bundles are written. For audit use this is documented to sit on WORM/object-lock storage — which also means no one can delete a bundle until the lock expires, so set that retention period against the LEGAL retention period for what bundles hold (they can contain personal data: docs/data-handling.md, docs/design-export.md).

endpoint.description: Empty (the cloud's own API) or an http(s) base URL for an S3-compatible store, with a plain host[:port] and an optional path prefix. No credentials, query, fragment or bracketed IP literal. http:// requires allowHttp, and then only for a cluster-local or loopback host.

allowHttp.description: Talk to this endpoint over plain HTTP. In-cluster test endpoints only: the chart refuses to render it for an endpoint host that is not cluster-local or loopback, because sealed bundles would otherwise leave the cluster in plaintext.

networkPolicy.description: An ingress NetworkPolicy for the controller pod. Enabling it DENIES every ingress the rules do not allow, pod-wide; the chart re-opens the webhook port to `from`, the health port to `healthFrom`, and the mcp port to mcp.networkPolicy.from when mcp.enabled.

from.description: Peers allowed to reach the webhook port. Required when enabled.

healthFrom.description: Peers allowed to reach the health port (8081: /healthz and /metrics). Empty (default) renders a rule with no `from`, i.e. from anywhere: the kubelet's address is unknowable to a chart and the series carry no incident content, while a wrong value fails the probes and takes the pod out of the webhook Service.

maxCapturesPerPayload.description: Most captures one webhook payload may create; 0 = unlimited. Alerts past it are counted in lapilli_alerts_dropped_total{reason="payload-cap"}.

routes.description: Notification destinations. A CaptureProfile may only name one of these; it cannot define a route, point it elsewhere, or raise its detail level.

host.description: host[:port], never a URL: no scheme, no path, no credentials. Lives here rather than in the Secret so a change rolls the pod and cannot silently repoint the endpoint.

pathSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with a `path` key, e.g. /services/T000/B000/xxxx. Only that key is mounted.

detail.description: facts: no value taken from the workload. content: also the changed field and its redacted before/after values. A log line is never sent in either mode.

includeDemo.description: Also announce captures labelled lapilli.dev/export: local, which is what `lapilli demo` creates.

insecureHttp.description: Talk to this route over plain HTTP. Tests only: it also needs LAPILLI_NOTIFY_ALLOW_HTTP in extraEnv, and even then only a cluster-local or loopback host is accepted.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds the kubelet waits after SIGTERM before SIGKILL. Lapilli needs at least 25: the captures in flight get 12s and the notification flush 10s, and a truncated flush marks captures notified that were never announced.

retention.description: Bundle lifecycle. Nothing deletes a sealed bundle unless this is enabled; see docs/design-retention.md. "Keep forever" is a capacity problem (a full volume makes EVERY capture fail) AND a liability one: redaction is best-effort and logs are not redacted, so bundles may hold personal data nobody has reviewed (docs/data-handling.md).

maxBytes.description: Ceiling for the bundle volume in bytes. Empty = derived from persistence.size x 0.8; "0" disables the byte bound.

days.description: Also reclaim bundles older than this many days. 0 = off. A secondary trim: on the default 1Gi volume an age window never engages before the disk fills.

minFreeBytes.description: Refuse to start a capture with less than this free, so it fails with a pvc-full reason code instead of a raw ENOSPC part-way through collection. 0 = off.

allowUnexported.description: Reclaim bundles that reached no destination. On a PVC-only install that is the only copy of the evidence, so this is off by default and must be chosen deliberately.

reclaimOrphans.description: Reclaim files whose IncidentCapture no longer exists. Off by default: nothing in Lapilli deletes a capture, so this would let one `kubectl delete incidentcapture --all` authorise a mass delete.

networkPolicy.description: An ingress NetworkPolicy restricting who may reach the mcp port. Like every ingress policy it denies all other ingress to the pod, so the chart also re-opens the webhook and health ports unless webhook.networkPolicy is on.

from.description: Peers allowed to reach the mcp port. Required whenever an ingress policy is rendered and mcp.enabled: the port serves bundle contents, so an empty list — which would allow every pod in the cluster — is refused at render time.
